description: Check in one call whether LPF covers a brand, model or part type at all, before you search. Use list_models to page through models, get_model_parts for a model's part numbers, and resolve_request or search_parts to find a specific part. Default (summary omitted or false): totals, brands, part types and every model with its part types and fit counts, about 1 MB. summary true: the same without the models list (models_omitted gives the count), about 6 KB; use it for brand or part-type questions, and the full mode only to look up a specific model. Both are a snapshot built from the dataset at deploy time: generated is the build date and data_revision changes only when the data or server changes. Not listed means no documented fit, not incompatibility. Read-only.

summary.description: Optional, default false. true omits the per-model list (same as REST /api/coverage?summary=1).

name: get_coverage

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get coverage manifest
